scope: Both native and production item paths consume the 4db510 stream (animations.visual_rng) and preserve a seeded 4db508 ANM/shake stream. Retail ECL 509 4277fd -> 421560/4215b0 against production EnemyScriptServices dispatch and ItemManager::drop. Spell-practice mask 0x30==0x20 skips all side effects. Ordinary power/point types 1/2: initial signed RNG even for empty drops, per-item unit/random turns, polar scatter, wrapping angle, allocation order and clamped positions. Native loop emits types 1..12 but clears thirteen count words; the thirteenth nonzero word is tested. Native 4397b0 factory is controlled here; its actual type-1/2 pool allocation, timers and two ANM requests are measured separately in th14-item-verified.json. The port uses synthetic ANM scripts. Other item types, ordinary pickup/auto-attract combo rewards, resource animation pixels and complete gameplay remain unverified.
